parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: The version number of the atomic host to be deployed. Providing latest will upgrade to the latest available version. Default: "latest"

examples:
- name: Upgrade the atomic host platform to the latest version (atomic host upgrade)
  community.general.atomic_host:
    revision: latest

- name: Deploy a specific revision as the atomic host (atomic host deploy 23.130)
  community.general.atomic_host:
    revision: 23.130

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: The command standard output. Returned: always Sample: "Already on latest"
